sources.title: GitHub - a1exus/koda: No cloud, no accounts — pick a model, run one ...
sources.snippet: Run AI models on your own machine. Pick a model, run one command, get a chat interface and an API — no cloud, no accounts, no data leaving your device. Works with OpenCode, VS Code Copilot, Cursor, Hermes Agent, Pi, and any OpenAI-compatible client. Technical overview Koda is a thin Makefile orchestration layer over llama.cpp.
